name: Osanami Youka
source:
[url=/c89999]Kuzumi Kiyoshirou[/url]'s childhood friend, a second-year student.

As the center of attention in the class, she exudes a bright and infectious energy that draws people to her. Youka mostly surrounded by her ever-expanding friend group. She is also consistently on top of the latest trends and gossips.
Although distance has grown between Youka and Kuzumi, she still thinks of him fondly and cares for him deeply.

Going home style: With friends!
Youka's idea of going home is never a solitary journey; she always has her friends by her side. Even if Kuzumi happens to be her companion, her friends will join in, and the group will inevitably turn it into a fun-filled adventure. It's rare for Youka and Kuzumi to have one-on-one time, so those moments are special!
